reviews.review: Its basically 1970s retro-future space, you are a hippie with a laser gun and you're fighting aliens on a space station. It is very very similar to left 4 dead when it comes to special alien variety (grabbers, goopers, charging bull type enemies, etc). Its fun, but there's nothing really that sets it apart from left 4 dead - its basically just a reskinned version of that game. There are laser smgs, shotguns, rifles, etc. different variations of grenades, turrets. Instead of bashing people away with right mouse button you press shift to force them back with a shockwave. You go on special item retrieval missions where you have to take turns holding a hot potato item while everyone else defends against the incoming waves...again its all just small variations on a very similar base. Would I recommend it? Sure, for a price of about $5-$10
